messages:
Maria (CS): FYI — Atlas reached out requesting support for a new KnowledgeOps "knowledgebot" initiative. They want to roll across support + docs teams. Asking for capacity guidance (throughput + embeddings) and an enablement plan. Can we triage?

Jon (AE): Thanks. Do we know expected traffic patterns? Hosted vs Dedicated? Any timeline / renewal influence?

Priya (Atlas Prod): Hey all — quick context: pilot with 8 agents now, goal is 50 agents in 6 weeks. Each agent ~25–35 requests/minute, responses average ~400–600 tokens. We also plan nightly embedding pipeline for ~50k docs/day (vector DB is self-hosted). Timeline is aggressive — want to go to Prod in ~4–6 weeks. Renewal isn't immediate but this is likely to drive a bigger contract.

Sam (SE): Got it. Sounds embed-heavy + sustained low-latency generation. Two asks: 1) estimate Dedicated sizing for steady-state 50 agents, 2) recommended model/quantization and batching to hit latency SLOs.

Sam (SE): Example high-level profile: 
```
expected_load:
  agents: 50
  avg_rpm_per_agent: 30
  avg_tokens_per_resp: 500
  embeddings_per_day: 50000
```

Sam (SE): With that, rough ballpark: Dedicated pool with 4x A100-equivalent slots (or equivalent multi-node T4/RTX clusters with batching tuned) + automatic KV prefix caching for docs and streaming disabled for embed-heavy paths. Also recommend quantized gpt-like open model with 8-bit kernels for cost.

Maria (CS): Helpful — Kevin, can you draft an enablement checklist? We should offer a joint scoping call (SE + Onboard + Atlas Prod) ASAP. Also capture this as an expansion opportunity in CRM — likely >3x usage.

Kevin (Onboard PM): On it. Suggested enablement plan (high level): 1) 60-min kickoff scoping call; 2) integration checklist (vector DB creds, ingest cadence, retry/backoff); 3) onboarding runbook + alerting thresholds; 4) 2 enablement sessions for devs + ops; 5) 2-week canary with traffic shaping. Target kickoff next Tue.

Jon (AE): I'll update CRM with expansion flag and estimated ARR uplift. Can we get a rough cost delta for Hosted vs Dedicated to share in the call?

Sam (SE): Yes — I'll prep a short cost/latency matrix and 2 config options (min-cost vs low-latency). Also add a fallback plan: hosted fallback for peak bursts if dedicated pool saturated.

Priya (Atlas Prod): Thanks team. Prefer Dedicated for predictable latency. Also: we use a self-hosted vector DB (Pinecone-like) so want clear guidance on connection timeouts and batching.

Maria (CS): Noted. Next steps: Sam to produce sizing + cost matrix by EOD tomorrow; Kevin to publish onboarding checklist and schedule kickoff; Jon to mark CRM opportunity and loop in enterprise AE.

deploy-bot: New onboarding playbook created — /playbooks/atlas-knowledgeops-ramp (internal link) :rocket:

Kevin (Onboard PM): I've created the checklist and put a Doodle for Tue at 10/13/14 PT.

Jon (AE): +1 schedule. Priya, we'll send invite shortly.

Priya (Atlas Prod): Great — thanks everyone :+1:

Maria (CS): Marking as high expansion signal and tagging for quarterly review. Will follow up after the scoping call.

Sam (SE): Quick note: adding recommendation to use prefix KV caching for repeated user prompts to cut token cost ~30% in similar customers.

Maria (CS): Awesome. cc @Kevin for SRE contacts and @Jon for commercial.
